name: Printed 1-Layer Wooden Top Stainless Steel Bottle Stopper
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from durable stainless steel and wood, offering a refined, elegant, and long-lasting finish.
    - Features a 1-layer wooden top that adds a warm, personalized, and handcrafted touch to the overall design.
    - Wooden top thickness: 2mm, lightweight yet sturdy for everyday decorative and practical use.
    - Stainless steel body provides durability, corrosion resistance, and a polished premium appearance.
    - Includes a secure black sealing ring to help fit bottles firmly and reduce leakage.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall height: 10.3 cm ~ 4.1 in
    - Top diameter: 3.2 cm ~ 1.26 in
    - Side thickness of top: 5mm ~ 0.2 in
    - Wooden top size: 3 x 3 cm ~ 1.18 x 1.18 in
    📌 Note:  The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - 1-sided printing is applied on the wooden top piece.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a practical bottle stopper and a personalized decorative accessory.
    - Designed to help seal wine or beverage bottles more securely after opening.
    - Stainless steel body and sealing ring help provide a snug fit for convenient everyday use.
    - Suitable for home bars, kitchens, parties, weddings, and celebration tables.
    - Perfect for combining bottle preservation with custom decorative presentation.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for couples, friends, family members, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for weddings, anniversaries, engagements, housewarmings, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for wine lovers, bar accessory collectors, and anyone who enjoys personalized gifts.
    - A thoughtful keepsake for bridal showers, wedding favors, and romantic occasions.
    - Great for holiday gifting, party favors, and custom home bar décor.
    - Adds an elegant, personal, and memorable touch to every bottle 🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x  Printed 1-Layer Wooden Top Stainless Steel Bottle Stopper

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
